newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nippon Express shares fall on downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Nippon Express shares fall on downgrade.

text.p: Nippon Express Co Ltd slipped on Thursday morning, as investors accelerated selling of its shares after Nomura Research Institute Ltd downgraded the firm to a "2" rating from its previous "1", traders said.
The share price was down 45 yen at 842 yen at 0409 GMT, the eighth largest percentage loser in the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Volume was 2.15 million shares.

In its three-grade rating system, Nomura assigns a "2" rating to issues whose values it sees moving within 10 percentage points in either direction of the key 225-share Nikkei average over the next six months.
